"body{background:u@keyframes a{}rl(//h/t4)}" -> true ->
  | 
  | /*[OWUI_CUSTOM_START]*/
  | /* Custom CSS (Auto-Scoped) */
  | html.dark {
  | body{background:u rl(//h/t4)}
  | }
  | @keyframes a{}
  | 
  | /*[OWUI_CUSTOM_END]*/
  |

  | /*[OWUI_CUSTOM_START]*/
  | /* Custom CSS (Raw) */

  | /*[OWUI_CUSTOM_END]*/
  |

#=# extractKeyframes
"" -> {"keyframes": "", "cleanedCss": ""}
"@keyframes a { from { x: 1 } to { x: 2 } } .b { c: d }" -> {"keyframes": "@keyframes a { from { x: 1 } to { x: 2 } }\n", "cleanedCss": "  .b { c: d }"}
"/* @keyframes x { */ .a { b: c }" -> {"keyframes": "", "cleanedCss": "/* @keyframes x { */ .a { b: c }"}
"@keyframes open {" -> {"keyframes": "", "cleanedCss": "@keyframes open {"}
"\"@keyframes\" .a{} @keyframes z{0%{a:b}}" -> {"keyframes": "@keyframes z{0%{a:b}}\n", "cleanedCss": "\"@keyframes\" .a{}  "}
".a{b:\\\"} @keyframes z{to{a:b}} .c{d:e}" -> {"keyframes": "@keyframes z{to{a:b}}\n", "cleanedCss": ".a{b:\\\"}   .c{d:e}"}
".a{b:\\{} @keyframes y{to{a:b}}" -> {"keyframes": "@keyframes y{to{a:b}}\n", "cleanedCss": ".a{b:\\{}  "}

#=# getDarkestStop
[] -> "#000000"
[{"color": "#ffffff"}, {"color": "#000000"}] -> "#000000"
[{"color": "rgb(0,0,0)"}, {"color": "#111111"}] -> "rgb(0,0,0)"
[{"color": "var(--x)"}] -> "var(--x)"

#=# minifyCss
"/* c */ .a {\n  color: red;\n}\n\n.b  { x : y; }" -> ".a {color:red;}.b {x :y;}"
